articles.title: Crypto’s first quantum attack will look like unexplained breach: Quantus founder
articles.snippet: Bad actors with access to a cryptography-breaking quantum computer probably won’t try to announce it to the world by hacking Satoshi Nakamoto’s high-profile Bitcoin wallets, crypto executives say.

articles.title: Bitcoin Red Team Says AI Is Finding Critical Exploits Across Core Projects
articles.snippet: A volunteer security effort says it has scanned 150 Bitcoin repositories, disclosed more than a dozen vulnerabilities, and is building an open-source AI platform to automate software security reviews.

articles.title: Robinhood Crypto Chief Explains Why There Are 'Two Wolves' Inside Robinhood Chain
articles.snippet: “We want to show customers that we care about what they care about," Robinhood head of crypto Johann Kerbrat told Decrypt.
